CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is elite enemy scale (30-50 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a CONTROLLER unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Chain Auditor, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Elite.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: CONTROLLER.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW CHAIN AUDITOR — A bent accountant-devil made of chains and ledgers.

BODY: Bent, hunched humanoid — 25-30 feet. The body is composed of CHAINS and LEDGER FRAGMENTS — not void-stuff flesh, but an amalgamation of broken metal chains and shattered stone tablets that form a roughly humanoid shape. The chains are dark iron-black, rusted, and the tablets are dark stone covered in erasing text (abstract patterns, NOT readable). The body is bent forward, hunched, as if perpetically examining something. The form looks like a clerk or accountant — but made of the tools of their trade gone wrong.

MASK: No eyes — the face is a blank void-stuff oval where a face should be, but several chain-links hang across where eyes would be, like a blindfold made of broken chains. No mouth. No nose. Just chains across absence.

CONTRACT SEAMS: Burning white contract seams run through the body — NOT fire, NOT warm light, but cold white anti-light burning along the seams where chains meet tablets. The seams are the visual representation of contracts being audited and consumed. Each seam pulses with cold white anti-light.

LEDGERS: Shattered stone ledger-tablets are embedded throughout the body — in the torso, arms, and legs. Each tablet is covered in abstract erasing patterns (NOT text). The tablets are the records of consumed civilizations — debts, contracts, oaths — all being erased. The tablets occasionally CRACK further, splitting along old fault lines as more is consumed.

GATE STONE: A large broken contract-stone (dark iron-grey) is embedded in the center of the back — the stone is cracked, with a broken Gate-arch symbol carved into it. Cold white anti-light bleeds from the stone. Chains wrap around the stone, anchoring it to the body.

POSE: Bent forward, one chain-arm extended, examining a floating ledger-fragment. The pose of an auditor reviewing records — but the records are being consumed, not examined. The Auditor should look like a clerk frozen mid-audit, but the clerk is made of the very records it is destroying.

SCALE: 25-30 feet. Camera at medium angle, looking at the bent form. The Chain Auditor should look COLD and PROCEDURAL — not violent, not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in a bureaucratic way. This is what happens when the system that tracks reality breaks down.

GROUND: The ground around the Chain Auditor is covered in fallen ledger-fragments — shattered tablets, broken chains, scattered contract-stones. White anti-light fracture lines in grid patterns — the ghost of a filing system, a ledger-book grid erased. Ash falling upward. The earth looks like a records hall that has been emptied.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment that looks like a RECORDS HALL or COURT-ARCHIVE — but wrong. Broken shelves, shattered archive stones, fallen chain-curtains. The space feels like a bureaucratic office that has been consumed. Palette: charcoal-black, iron-grey, cold white, stone-dark, faint contract-seam white-blue.

VFX: Burning white contract seams pulsing. Chains clinking and shifting. Ledger-tablets cracking further. Anti-light absorption. Chains wrapping and unwrapping slowly. The body should feel like it is AUDITING reality and finding it wanting.

SILHOUETTE: Bent, hunched, chain-covered, ledger-embedded. Reads as a controller/bureaucrat unit — the hunched posture and chain/ledger body are the primary identifiers. Should look like a bureaucratic nightmare — the system that tracks existence, broken and consuming what it was meant to protect.
